name: SaaSWaitlist
description: Discover, showcase, and join waitlists for upcoming SaaS products. A Next.js 16 + Firebase platform with an admin dashboard for managing projects and Cloudinary image uploads. Live: https://projektnotify.vercel.app

paragraphs: Discover, showcase, and join waitlists for upcoming SaaS products.
A modern waitlist management platform where makers list upcoming SaaS products and visitors join their waitlists. Built with Next.js 16 (App Router), Firebase, and Cloudinary.
features: Project showcase — a featured grid on the landing page, a full /projects directory, and rich detail pages (/projects/[slug]) with an image gallery, Markdown description, key features, and tech stack.
Waitlist signup — visitors join a project's waitlist by email, with per-project duplicate detection.

Admin dashboard — email/password sign-in with full project CRUD: Live / Coming Soon status, Cloudinary image gallery upload, a Markdown editor with live preview, plus tags, category, pricing, tech stack, features, and…
Polished UI — dark/light theme, Framer Motion animations, shadcn/ui components, and a fully responsive layout.

whatItDoes.text: Discover, showcase, and join waitlists for upcoming SaaS products.

requirements.text: Admin dashboard — email/password sign-in with full project CRUD: Live / Coming Soon status, Cloudinary image gallery upload, a Markdown editor with live preview, plus tags, category, pricing, tech stack, features, and launch date.
Enable the Email/Password provider in Firebase Authentication, then create admin users manually (there is no self-signup or Google sign-in).
